questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

C _ B N _ _ V_ _ H C _ B _ H
questions.solution:
Given :- C _ B N _ _ V_ _ H C _ B _ H

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) VHCBNVN → C **V** B N **H - C** V **B N** H - C **V** B **N** H

 
• Here **"CVBNH" **is repeated.

2) HVCNBVN → C **H** B N **V - C **V **N B** H - C **V** B** N** H

3) VCBHNVN → C **V** B N **C - B** V **H N** H - C **V** B **N** H

4) VHBNCHV → C **V** B N **H - B** V **N C** H - C **H** B **V** H

 
• Option (1) gives the pattern of :- C V B N H - C V B N H - C V B N H

Hence, the correct answer is **"VHCBNVN".**

questions.question: If the signs ‘+’ and ‘÷ ' are interchanged, then which of the following equations can be correctly balanced?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f02765b3856b25e91bd1603f4e3e4475f16aaa1a4024b3ce39723d68b69bcfb4.png] 

Option 1) : 22 + 11 × 8 ÷ 3 = 19 

After interchanging the symbols '+' and '÷' the equation is as follows : 22 ÷ 11 × 8 + 3 = 19

⇒ __**22 ÷ 11**__ × 8 + 3 = 19

⇒ __**2 × 8**__ + 3 = 19

⇒ __**16 + 3 **__= 19

⇒ **19 = 19**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) : 24 – 12 ÷ 6 + 3 = 20

After interchanging the symbols '+' and '÷' the equation is as follows : 24 - 12 + 6 ÷ 3 = 20

⇒ 24 - 12 + __**6 ÷ 3**__ = 20

⇒ __**24**__ - 12 __**+ 2**__ = 20

⇒ __**26 - 12**__ = 20

⇒ 14 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 12 + 4 – 8 ÷ 3 = 11 

After interchanging the symbols '+' and '÷' the equation is as follows : 12 ÷ 4 - 8 + 3 = 11

⇒ __**12 ÷**____** 4**__ - 8 + 3 = 11

⇒ __**3**__ - 8 __**+ 3**__ = 11

⇒ __**6**____** - 8**__ = 11

⇒ - 2 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : 16 + 4 × 8 ÷ 3 = 45 

After interchanging the symbols '+' and '÷' the equation is as follows : 16 ÷ 4 × 8 + 3 = 45

⇒ __**16 ÷ 4**__ × 8 + 3 = 45

⇒ __**4 × 8**__ + 3 = 45

⇒ __**32 + 3**__ = 45

⇒ 35 ≠ 45

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"22 + 11 × 8 ÷ 3 = 19".**

questions.question:
If A denotes ‘addition’, B denotes ‘multiplication’, C denotes ‘subtraction’, and D denotes ‘division’, then what will be the value of the following expression?

46 C (6 A 7) B 5 A 24 D 6 B (27 D (9 D 3))
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c4584948ae9ceabb7671b661eadd345def8889d41bf9d1f0dec1f69b27e8fbc.png] 

A denotes ‘addition’, B denotes ‘multiplication’, C denotes ‘subtraction’, and D denotes ‘division’,

 
 

 **Alphabet**
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 **Symbol**
 +
 × 
 -
 ÷ 
 
 

Given equation : 46 C (6 A 7) B 5 A 24 D 6 B (27 D (9 D 3))

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 46 - (6 + 7) × 5 + 24 ÷ 6 × (27 ÷ (9 ÷ 3))

= 46 - (6 + 7) × 5 + 24 ÷ 6 × (27 ÷ __**(9 ÷ 3)**__)

= 46 - __**(6 + 7)**__ × 5 + 24 ÷ 6 × __**(27 ÷ 3)**__

= 46 - 13 × 5 + __**24 ÷ 6**__ × 9

= 46 - __**13 × 5**__ + __**4 × 9**__

= __**46**__ - 65 __**+ 36**__

= __**82 - 65**__

= **17**

Hence, the correct answer is **"17".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All fruits are leaves.

Some mangoes are rotten.

All rotten are fruits.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some leaves are rotten.

II. Some mangoes are fruits.

III. All leaves are either rotten or mangoes.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d024967e992d54759203973725be1bca6bfaf1d160fb461c72e6a2786cbe8d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some leaves are rotten → True (As All rotten are fruits and All fruits are leaves so, Some leaves are rotten is true)

II. Some mangoes are fruits → True (As All rotten are fruits and Some mangoes are rotten so, Some mangoes are fruits is true)

III. All leaves are either rotten or mangoes → False (As All rotten are fruits and All fruits are leaves and Some mangoes are rotten so, All leaves are either rotten or mangoes is false)

∴ Here, Only conclusions I and II are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions I and II follow".**
